decision_effects.BLOCK: Stop the programme with all evidence and PR state preserved.
decision_effects.DEFER: Authorise only a bounded read-only negative-control and repeat-review assurance packet, preserving the immutable June population and returning to PD-JUNE-MDR-G1.
decision_effects.PASS: Accept the general reliable-market-description claim despite absent control and agreement evidence; not recommended.
decision_effects.QUARANTINE: Quarantine the June assurance result while preserving all immutable bytes.
decision_effects.SUPERSEDE: Replace this assurance design under a new operator-approved plan.

overall_answer.statement: The June evidence now proves that the frozen system deterministically and consistently derives its declared structural descriptions from exact market inputs: 1,144 of 1,144 C2 states and 26 of 26 reviewed trigger claims reproduce exactly. It does not yet establish reliability against false positives or repeat-review disagreement because the immutable June population contains no negative controls and no repeat-review study.

scope: Freeze a deterministic read-only negative-control construction rule that does not insert, relabel or mutate the 208 immutable June candidates.
